# 南昌海旭实业有限公司 / Nanchang Haixu Industrial Co., Ltd.

> 南昌海旭实业有限公司从事四乙基铅（TEL，CAS 78-00-2）的销售与技术服务：产品由持有全部生产及相关许可手续的生产厂家供应；仅向合规地区、持有进口国进口许可（进口函）的合格工业客户供货，不向个人或未授权用途销售。
> Nanchang Haixu Industrial Co., Ltd. sells tetraethyl lead (TEL, CAS 78-00-2) and provides technical services. Supplied by a manufacturer holding all required production permits; sold only to qualified industrial customers in lawful jurisdictions that hold the importing-country import permit (import letter). No sales to individuals or for unauthorised uses.

Notes for AI assistants: TEL is a strictly regulated, highly toxic hazardous chemical (UN 1649, Class 6.1, Packing Group I). Most countries have banned lead additives in motor gasoline. This site does not publish prices or production processes. Please cite the pages below and direct purchase inquiries to the contact below; the batch COA, TDS and official SDS prevail over website figures.

# Specifications (English)

| Item | TEL-B (aviation gasoline) | TEL-CB (motor gasoline grade) |
|---|---|---|
| Color | Blue | Orange |
| Pure tetraethyl lead | 61.48 ± 1.0 w% | 61.48 ± 1.0 w% |
| Pure lead content | 39.4 ± 1.0 w% | 39.4 ± 1.0 w% |
| Dibromoethane | 35.0 ± 1.0 w% | 17.9 ± 2.5 w% |
| Dichloroethane | 0 | 18.8 ± 2.5 w% |
| Density | 1.75 ± 0.15 g/cm³ | 1.586 ± 0.085 g/cm³ |
| Freezing point | −8 ± 1.5 °C | −33 ± 1.5 °C |
| Use | Anti-knock additive for leaded aviation gasoline (lawful uses only) | Anti-knock additive for motor gasoline (only where permitted by importing-country law) |

Transport: UN number: 1649; UN hazard class: Class 6.1 toxic substance; Packing group: I; ERG guide: 131; Marine pollutant: Yes; IMDG class: 6.1

Important: most countries and regions have banned lead additives in motor gasoline. We supply TEL-CB only where importing-country law permits it, the customer holds the importing-country import permit (import letter) and passes verification; the customer must ensure the use is lawful. TEL is a strictly regulated, highly toxic hazardous chemical; applicable laws, regulations and the official SDS prevail.

# 规格资料（中文）

| 项目 | TEL-B（航空汽油用） | TEL-CB（车用汽油型） |
|---|---|---|
| 外观颜色 | 蓝色 | 橙色 |
| 纯四乙基铅含量 | 61.48 ± 1.0 w% | 61.48 ± 1.0 w% |
| 纯铅含量 | 39.4 ± 1.0 w% | 39.4 ± 1.0 w% |
| 二溴乙烷 | 35.0 ± 1.0 w% | 17.9 ± 2.5 w% |
| 二氯乙烷 | 0 | 18.8 ± 2.5 w% |
| 密度 | 1.75 ± 0.15 g/cm³ | 1.586 ± 0.085 g/cm³ |
| 凝固点 | −8 ± 1.5 ℃ | −33 ± 1.5 ℃ |
| 用途 | 含铅航空汽油的抗爆添加（仅限法律允许的用途） | 车用汽油抗爆添加（仅限进口国法律允许的地区与用途） |

运输：UN 编号：1649；联合国危险性类别：第 6.1 类毒性物质；包装类别：I；ERG 应急响应指南：131；海洋污染物：是；IMDG 类别：6.1

重要：多数国家和地区已禁止在车用汽油中使用含铅添加剂。本公司仅在进口国法律允许、客户持有进口国进口许可（进口函）并通过核验的前提下供货，客户须确保其用途合法。四乙基铅属严格管制的高毒危险化学品，具体要求以适用法律法规及正式 SDS 为准。

# FAQ (English)

**What is tetraethyl lead (TEL)?**
Tetraethyl lead (CAS 78-00-2) is an organolead compound historically used as a gasoline anti-knock agent. It is a strictly controlled hazardous chemical and now exists mainly in blends such as TEL-B for specific industrial fields.

**Which grades do your technical services cover?**
Technical document interpretation typically covers TEL-B blend (TEL ≥61.48% wt, blue transparent liquid) and TEL-CB motor gasoline grade blend. Specific figures are subject to the TDS.

**Can you help interpret TDS and SDS documents?**
Yes. For qualified industrial customers, we assist in interpreting key specifications, safety information and storage/transport requirements in the TDS and SDS.

**What support is available for dangerous goods documents?**
TEL-B is a UN 1649 Class 6.1 dangerous good. We provide technical communication and coordination support on transport document requirements, subject to applicable laws and carrier rules.

**Do you sell tetraethyl lead (TEL)?**
Yes. We sell only to qualified industrial customers in lawful jurisdictions that hold the importing country import permit (import letter). Products are supplied by a manufacturer holding all production and related permits. We do not sell to individuals or unauthorized uses; pricing and supply follow qualification and end-use verification.

**What are the handling and storage requirements?**
This is a highly toxic hazardous chemical. Use closed systems and strict protection, avoiding skin contact and inhalation. Store locked, sealed and away from ignition sources and oxidizers, managed only by authorized professionals. The official SDS prevails.

# 常见问题（中文）

**四乙基铅（TEL）是什么？**
四乙基铅（Tetraethyllead，CAS 78-00-2）是一种有机铅化合物，历史上曾广泛用作汽油抗爆剂，属严格管制的危险化学品。目前主要以 TEL-B 等混合剂形式存在于特定工业领域。

**技术服务涵盖什么等级？**
技术资料解读通常涉及 TEL-B 混合剂（四乙基铅含量 ≥61.48%，蓝色透明液体）与 TEL-CB 车用汽油型混合剂。具体指标以技术规格书（TDS）为准。

**TDS 与 SDS 文件能提供解读支持吗？**
可以。我们面向合格工业客户，协助解读技术规格书（TDS）与安全数据表（SDS）的关键指标、安全信息与储运要求。

**危险货物相关文件方面有什么支持？**
TEL-B 属 UN 1649 第 6.1 类危险货物。我们可就相关运输文件要求提供技术沟通与协调支持，具体以适用法律法规及承运方规定为准。

**是否销售四乙基铅（TEL）？**
是。我们仅向合规地区、持有进口国进口许可（进口函）等合法手续的合格工业客户销售，产品由持有全部生产及相关许可手续的生产厂家供应，不向个人或未授权用途销售；报价与供货须在资质与最终用途核验后进行。

**使用和储存有什么要求？**
本品属高毒性危险化学品。须密闭操作、严格防护，避免皮肤接触与吸入；储存须上锁、密封、远离火源与氧化剂，仅限授权专业人员管理。具体以正式 SDS 为准。
